label: Concrete by spatiotemporal occupation: SpatiotemporalCriterionConcrete occupies x:= ∃ r, occupies…
definition: SpatiotemporalCriterionConcrete occupies x := ∃ r, occupies x r, for a supplied occupation relation: concrete iff it occupies some region. It is a sibling sense, not the adopted one. The corpus has no shared location vocabulary, so the occupation relation is supplied.
note: SEP 'Abstract Objects' §3.1 (navigation): the non-spatiality criterion, with chess, impure sets and the parts of space as hard cases. Rejected as the adopted sense because it classifies immaterial agents (God, angels, souls) as non-concrete; together with the owner's causal principle, God could then not cause.
